title: test(cli): the absent-database suite gives each command and door its own hook, its runs started together
body:
Fixes #37183
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改了命令行工具里一份集成测试怎样安排它的子进程,产品行为和测试断言都不变。
- 为什么做:车队测试稳定性。这份测试在合并队列满载时把四十个子进程排队塞进同一个准备步骤,超过八分钟上限,把一个无关的合并请求踢出了队列。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是这份测试在满载时仍然变慢,或某个子进程超时并直接点名是哪条命令;产品不受影响,撤回这一个提交即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts` only. No production code, no vitest config, no case, assertion or test name changed (54 tests before and after).

**Where the 480 s went (measured, not assumed).** On `origin/main` the `[#21552] the rest of the family` describe had ONE `beforeAll` holding a seed child plus 40 CLI children run one after another (12 doors x 3 faces, plus the 4 already-exit-zero doors), under one 480 s hook timeout. Every child costs a near-constant ~6.7 s here (49 runs: mean 6.7 s, min 5.2 s, max 7.9 s), so that hook took **268.6 s of the file's 351.2 s**. The card's queue build ran the file in 585 s, about 11.5 s a child: 41 serial children then sum past 480 s while each stays far under its own 120 s budget. The hook timed out because the roster grew and the shard slowed, not because any one run hung.

**The change.**

- Each seed child is its own hook.
- Each #21529 command and each #21552 door gets ONE hook that starts its three faces (absent `--json`, absent human, booted `--json`) together; the four already-exit-zero doors share one hook. 16 run hooks + 2 seed hooks, registered in a loop, run in registration order (vitest 4.1.12 defaults `sequence.hooks` to `stack` when unset, which runs `beforeAll` hooks one after another; the cli config sets no `sequence.hooks`).
- Each child keeps its own `RUN_BUDGET_MS` (120 s) kill, so a batch ends within one run's budget however many children it holds. The hook timeout is that budget plus 30 s (`BATCH_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS` = 150 s, down from 480 s), so a hang now fails naming the run that hung, never as "Hook timed out". A new door adds a hook; no hook's bound grows with the roster.
- `settleBatch` waits for every run of a batch (`Promise.allSettled`), so no child outlives its hook, and fails with every run that failed.
- Header: the `test-budget` line's spawn count is corrected to the file as it stands (49 CLI spawns, twelve #21552 doors; the third audit twin was added without the count moving). Its SECONDS (450) is unchanged: no CI reading of the new shape exists yet. The docblock line "Every spawn runs in the hook" now says how the hooks are cut.

Not chosen, and why: a plain hook-timeout raise (the sum would keep growing with each door); dropping runs (every run is a distinct command/face/database triple the file pins); one shared booted artifact (each door already reuses the same two databases; the cost is per child, see below).

## Tests

One file, run under the shared verify lock on this 4-vCPU container (shared-box seconds; other agents' unlocked work was running). Before = `origin/main` code; after = this branch. The per-child and per-hook figures come from a scratch timing log added for the measurement only and not committed.

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| file alone (vitest Duration) | 351.22 s | 142.90 s (143.68 s uninstrumented, head `75c937cfa`) |
| slowest hook alone | 268.6 s (family `beforeAll`, 41 children) | 9.0 s (the already-exit-zero batch, 4 children) |
| mean / max child alone | 6.7 s / 7.9 s | 7.6 s / 9.0 s |
| beside two heavy cli integration files (`--maxWorkers=3`), vitest Duration of the three-file run | 339.40 s | 215.63 s |
| slowest hook beside them | 259.8 s | 14.2 s |
| mean / max child beside them | 6.6 s / 7.7 s | 12.1 s / 14.2 s |

The neighbours were `test/package-install-local-uninstall-cleanups.integration.test.ts` and `test/artifact-flag-precedence.integration.test.ts`. Under contention the after-shape's children slow to about 12 s, three at a time; the slowest hook stays at about a tenth of its 150 s budget and every child at about an eighth of its 120 s budget.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where a child's ~6.7 s goes.** With the queue tier's oclif manifest in place, `os --version` through the source entry takes 0.13-0.19 s, but one real command on the absent database takes 6.1-6.4 s (`migrate resume`, `migrate audit-metadata-bodies`, `secret rewrap`). The floor is the command's own stack boot through the source entry, not oclif's command table. Not filed: a cost observation outside this card, and the source entry is test infrastructure.
- **What this does not change on a saturated runner.** Starting three children at once only shortens the file when the runner has spare cores (alone here: 2.5x). On a shard with none, the file's wall can stay near the serial sum; what changes in every case is that no hook waits on more than one run's budget. The 450 s `test-budget` declaration is left as it is until a CI reading of the new shape exists.
- **Concurrency on the shared databases.** Within a batch, two runs read the absent path (no file is created, which the file still asserts) and one reads a booted database; no batch runs two children on the same booted database.

## Verification

Read first:

1. The two `for (const … of …) beforeAll(…)` loops: the per-command loop at module level and the per-door loop in the family describe.
2. `settleBatch`: every run of a batch is waited for before the hook fails.
3. `BATCH_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS` and its comment: why one run's budget bounds every hook.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 src/commands/migrate/data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts` on a built closure prints `Tests 54 passed (54)` in about 2.5 minutes, against about 6 minutes on `main`.

Local gates on head `75c937cfa` (the `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` list for this diff, reconciled with `--ran`): 54 derived, 52 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` each refuse with exit 3 because they need packages outside the cli closure built; CI runs both). `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first refused on this shallow clone (exit 3, its pinned fixture commit unreachable) and passed after that one commit was fetched. `--ran`: 54 accounted, 0 UNRUN. CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here. Since the base, 11 commits landed on `origin/main`; none touches `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate`, `packages/cli/bin` or the cli vitest config.
